status: Floor-only transport concept; static CAD envelopes, not a manufacturing release or operating mobile robot

requirements.station_access_goal: serve every stationary robot arm by parking its load deck within that arm's verified reach
requirements.navigation_precision_policy: track-level travel precision is not required; local sample reference and stationary holding are still required for handoff

cassette_interface.origin: cassette bottom centre; +X vehicle forward, +Y left, +Z up
cassette_interface.mount: flat support, unequal diagonal locating pins and matching clearance bores
cassette_interface.cassette_retention: two latch envelopes per bay; contact, release and sensing not implemented

handoff_requirements.status: requirements only; no registered stations, calibrated frames, reach solution or physical dock
required_per_station: vehicle parking pose relative to arm
all intended sample pickup and place poses
collision-checked approach and retreat with actual gripper

requires: cassette identities and batch manifest known
vehicle stopped and stationary holding confirmed
correct cassette and article fit qualified
station-specific reach and local load reference verified
vehicle parked inside station approach region
stationary holding confirmed and travel inhibited
local load reference verified within station error limit
all intended samples within verified arm/tool reach
station reach and collision checks accepted
robot grasp confirmed before sample release
stop and retain load on lost localization, obstacle, stale feedback, retention fault or manifest mismatch
manual recovery and sample reconciliation before restart

future_services.implementation: requirements only; no driver, scheduler, navigation or server
future_services.handoff: arm accesses samples on parked vehicle; local reference, holding feedback, gripper and cover handling unresolved; no bench shuttle or cassette transfer required

references.use: 127.76 by 85.48 mm nominal plate footprint only; plate height and article geometry are not universal
24 by 1.5/2.0 mL rotor example motivates a 24-place cassette; no centrifuge selected

limitations: Plate and tube bodies are closed solid reference envelopes, not manufacturer geometry or liquid volumes
Two plates or 48 tubes are concept capacities; full centrifuge batch coverage remains unknown until a rotor and labware manifest are chosen
Other labware requires additional measured inserts; anything is a design goal, not demonstrated universal compatibility
Floor_P2, Floor_T48 and Floor_Mixed share one floor platform; historical bench variants are retired from the active source
Floor geometry is a static envelope; no steering, wheel kinematics, navigation, dynamics, stability or door traversal is validated
Floor deck height is a concept parameter; no lift is implemented and reach from every arm is a requirement, not a verified capability
Parking precision, local load registration, stationary holding, dock and cover handling are unresolved; removing the track does not verify sample pickup accuracy
Pins, retainers, cover and bumper are concept geometry; no article fit, holding force, spill, vibration, cleaning or contamination qualification
Cover is not a sealed or aerosol-tight container and has no modeled release mechanism
Cassette keying is TR01-specific; H01 and C01 require explicit adapters and are not automatically compatible
No payload rating, range, runtime, speed, temperature performance or cost is established; transporter budget is additional to the arm estimate
No ROS, SiLA, hardware control, physical feedback or safety validation; protocol entries are requirements rather than executable actions
Native CAD edits do not update the shared source; change source and regenerate to keep dimensions and anchors together
